title: Grateful Dead Live at The Warehouse on 1970-02-01
lineage: SBD > Bill Gadsen Reels > C > DAT > WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good‑sounding historic performance highlighted by an epic Lovelight
ai_review.review: The recording captures a classic early‑Dead show with Pigpen front and centre; reviewers rave about the long, trippy Lovelight that serves as the night’s centerpiece. Sound quality is described as good, making the historic moments easy to enjoy despite the lack of detailed technical notes.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are favorable (4‑5 stars) and consistently praise the musical performance, especially Lovelight, while noting only generic “good sound” for the recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention the sound is good but give no specifics about source type or mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A historic early‑Dead set dominated by Pigpen, with a very long Lovelight that many reviewers cite as the highlight of the evening.
